title: Mio, My Son
author: Astrid Lindgren
short_summary: Bosse is a lonely foster boy in Stockholm who is magically transported to the fairy-tale land of Farawayland, where he discovers he is really Prince Mio, son of the King of Farawayland. Alongside his loyal new friend Pompoo, Mio must journey to the frightening Land Beyond to confront the evil knight Sir Kato and free the children he has enchanted.
extended_summary:
Bosse is a lonely boy living with a foster family in Stockholm who does not treat him with much warmth or love. One evening, a magical encounter carries him away to Farawayland, a beautiful kingdom where he learns he is actually Prince Mio, the long-lost son of the King. In this new world he finally feels the love and belonging he always longed for, and he quickly becomes close friends with a boy named Pompoo, who has a small dog and a gift for whittling wonderful wooden flutes.

But Farawayland's peace is threatened by Sir Kato, a cruel knight who lives in the Land Beyond and has been stealing and enchanting children, turning some into birds and others to stone with his terrible power. Armed with a magic sword, a loyal white horse, and a protective cloak given to him for his journey, Mio sets out with Pompoo on a dangerous quest through dark forests and grim landscapes to reach Sir Kato's castle. Through courage, loyalty, and love rather than raw strength alone, Mio ultimately faces the evil knight and works to free the enchanted children, discovering along the way what it truly means to be brave.
